versions.short: The bill would direct the Secretary of the Interior to study whether an area along California's Monterey Bay coast, covering Monterey, San Mateo, Santa Cruz, and San Luis Obispo counties and possibly nearby areas with similar heritage, should be designated as a National Heritage Area called the Monterey Bay National Heritage Area. The study would be done in consultation with the State of California, local governments, tribal governments, nonprofit groups, and other appropriate organizations, including the Monterey Bay Economic Partnership, and would follow existing federal law on heritage area studies.
